entity.summary: Standalone centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched by Revolut in May 2024 for advanced crypto trading. Revolut X remains an active dedicated trading platform with web, mobile, API, order-book, deposit, and withdrawal functionality.
entity.notes: Revolut launched Revolut X as a standalone crypto exchange on 2024-05-07. Current first-party help and 2026 corporate materials show the exchange remains active. The September 2026 Revolut customer-data disclosure is tracked separately in issue #985 and is not attached to this entity as a canonical event unless direct Revolut X impact is established.

events.title: Revolut launched Revolut X
events.description: Revolut launched Revolut X as a standalone centralized cryptocurrency exchange for experienced traders, initially offering desktop order-book trading to UK Revolut customers.
events.notes: Exact launch date and standalone-exchange identity are established by Revolut's first-party launch announcement.

evidence.title: Revolut launches Revolut X, a stand-alone crypto trading platform for experienced traders
evidence.notes: First-party launch announcement identifies Revolut X as a standalone crypto exchange and gives the exact 2024-05-07 launch date.

evidence.title: Get started with Revolut X
evidence.notes: Current first-party help page describes Revolut X as Revolut's cryptocurrency trading platform and documents current onboarding and account access.

evidence.title: Revolut Receives In-Principle Approval to Provide Crypto Services in UAE
evidence.notes: First-party 2026 announcement says Revolut serves crypto customers through its retail app and standalone exchange Revolut X, describing current UK and EEA crypto-trading availability and planned UAE expansion.
